findings.title: NTP on-wire seconds wrap without era procedures
findings.description: RFC 5905 uses 32-bit NTP seconds. Operational era handling is not fully specified for long-horizon deployments.

evidence.quote: The 32-bit seconds field wraps around every 136 years

findings.machine_interpretation: Potential Y2036-related assurance gap for era disambiguation.
findings.recommendation_level1: Clarify era rollover and supported operational horizon.
findings.scope_rationale: This matters to time assurance because NTP seconds are a fixed-width counter that wraps on a known horizon.
